Obamacare must go! The Affordable Care Act is not affordable—it has wrecked the individual market for health insurance, with soaring premiums, limited choices, and per-enrollee Medicaid expansion costs nearly 50% above estimates. It requires continuously expanding taxpayer subsidies to fund it and is nothing more than a backdoor attempt at socialized medicine, which multiple countries have proven doesn’t work.
Obamacare stuffs insurance companies’ pockets with billions, then slams taxpayers with the tab—plus sky-high premiums and brutal deductibles. How is that fair?

.@SenJohnKennedy nails it. Schumer’s pushing the dumbest idea ever: permanently handing health insurance companies tens of billions in taxpayer cash every year, with zero promise they’ll lower premiums.

How’s that supposed to cut costs? It won’t. Those companies will just stuff the money in their pockets. It’s not rocket science.

Extend Biden’s COVID-era Obamacare subsidies that go directly to huge health insurance companies—who have been unjustly enriched by Obamacare at the expense of hardworking Americans?

No way. 

Not now, not ever!

Obamacare hasn’t worked. Since its implementation, insurance companies have only gotten richer while premiums for hardworking Americans have skyrocketed.

Extending Biden’s COVID-era Obamacare subsidies is like putting fresh paint on rotten wood. It does nothing to fix the rot.

For years, greedy insurance giants have pocketed massive profits—bankrolled by hardworking American taxpayers—while healthcare worsens, with soaring premiums and crushing deductibles.

The Obamacare money-laundering scheme must be dismantled. https://t.co/or7m24fDZf
